payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (merged). Pure-Rust call E2EE (x25519-dalek ECDH + chacha20poly1305 AEAD + HKDF): per-call epoch MediaKey, CallKeyManager (rotate on membership change, 1 previous epoch), per-recipient sealed key envelopes, sender-key relay envelope. FR-210 carried (senderId never truncated). 5 tests; verified no native crypto deps added. Built by a subagent.
